entries.speaker: Man in a Suit
entries.en: Charges have been filed against you.

entries.speaker: Man in a Suit
entries.en: The person who raised these allegations[n]is Suguru Kamoshida. I assume you know[n]him.
entries.uk: Заяву подав Суґуру Камошіда.[n]Гадаю, ти його знаєш.

entries.speaker: Man in a Suit
entries.en: Had that been it, we wouldn't be here[n]right now...
entries.uk: Якби на цьому все, нас би зараз[n]тут не було...

entries.speaker: Man in a Suit
entries.en: However, your prior criminal assault[n]means you are currently on probation,[n]correct?
entries.uk: Однак через попередній напад ти зараз[n]на випробувальному терміні, так?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Tch, didn't I tell you to behave yourself?
entries.uk: Тц, я ж казав тобі поводитися чемно?

entries.speaker: Man in a Suit
entries.en: Well then, you're coming with us.[n]I'm sorry, but it has to be now.
entries.uk: Що ж, ти підеш із нами.[n]Вибач, але мусимо зараз.
